children: New Delhi, Sept. 15 -- Most Tata Group stocks, including TCS, Tata Chemicals, and Tata Motors PV, surged up to 20% in morning deals on the BSE on Tuesday, 15 September, after the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) rejected Tata Sons' submission to remain private.
